Patches:
  - I/O backends: Local + File + Image only (no Firebase / Drive / WebDAV)
  - init14 reads window.MYMIND_MAP_CSS instead of fetch("map.css")
  - window.MyMind { getJSON, loadJSON, newMap, subscribe }; preserves onReady
Analytics, gtag, firebase scripts, and the Font Awesome CDN are not shipped.
The last map is saved privately.
